tracesTo: SOW: Onboarding, Roles & Access Control - Custom invite links created by the FSHQ League Admin
UserFlow: Manager / Fan Onboarding, Claiming & Role Assignment
Research: Discord-style instant join via invite links (slack-communities.md, discord-communities.md)

stories.title: Admin Creates Custom League Invite Link
stories.goal: generate a custom invite link for my league
stories.benefit: I can easily share league access with prospective members without manual approval for each person
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access invite link generation from league admin dashboard
Admin can configure invite link options: expiration date, max uses, and default role assignment (manager/fan)
System generates unique, secure invite URL with random token (e.g., https://fshq.gg/invite/abc123xyz)
Admin can set invite link to auto-approve or require manual approval after acceptance
System displays generated invite link with copy-to-clipboard functionality
Admin can preview what new users will see when accessing the invite link
System validates that invite link configuration complies with league visibility rules

stories.title: Admin Shares Invite Link via Multiple Channels
stories.goal: distribute my league invite link through email, messaging apps, and social media
stories.benefit: I can reach potential members through their preferred communication channels
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can send invite link via email through integrated SendGrid email interface with customizable message
System provides shareable text template including invite link and league description for copy-paste sharing
Admin can generate QR code for invite link for in-person sharing or print materials
System tracks invite link shares by method (email sent count, copy actions, QR code generations)
Admin can preview email invitation before sending with dynamic template showing league name and inviter details
System integrates with league's configured email domain for professional appearance
Admin can send bulk invitations to multiple email addresses simultaneously with personalization

stories.title: Admin Views Active Invite Links
stories.goal: see all active invite links for my league with their usage statistics
stories.benefit: I can monitor which invite links are performing well and manage outdated or compromised links
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access invite link management dashboard from league admin area
Dashboard displays all active invite links with creation date, expiration date, and creator name
System shows usage metrics for each link: total clicks, successful registrations, and remaining available uses
Admin can filter invite links by status (active, expired, fully-used, revoked)
Dashboard shows conversion funnel: link clicks → account creations → league joins for each invite
System highlights invite links approaching expiration or use limits with visual indicators
Admin can sort invite links by creation date, usage count, or expiration date

stories.title: Admin Revokes or Extends Invite Link
stories.goal: deactivate a compromised invite link or extend the expiration of a popular link
stories.benefit: I can maintain control over league access and respond to changing invitation needs
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can revoke any active invite link immediately from invite management dashboard
System displays confirmation prompt before revoking with option to provide reason for audit trail
Revoked invite links show 'This invitation is no longer valid' message when accessed
Admin can extend expiration date of active invite link without changing the URL
Admin can increase max usage limit for invite link that is approaching its cap
System logs all revocation and modification actions in league admin history
Admin can optionally notify users who joined via specific link when it's being revoked

stories.title: Admin Creates Role-Specific Invite Links
stories.goal: generate separate invite links that automatically assign users to specific roles or teams
stories.benefit: I can streamline onboarding for different types of members without manual role assignment
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create invite link pre-configured for 'Manager' role with available team selection during registration
Admin can create invite link pre-configured for 'Fan' role with optional favorite team selection
System validates team availability for manager invite links before allowing creation
Invite link URL contains role indication for tracking (e.g., /invite/managers/abc123 vs /invite/fans/xyz789)
System enforces role-specific constraints during registration (team claiming for managers, no claim for fans)
Admin can set invite link to assign users to specific team automatically without user selection
Role-specific invite links display appropriate onboarding flow based on configured role
